def factor_volume_stability_bounded(df):
    """Negative coefficient of variation of log1p volume with denominator mean + std, attenuated by true range volatility compression."""
    df_copy = df.copy()

    # Primary mechanism: negative CV of log1p volume over 20 bars, denominator regularized by std
    window = 20
    log_volume = np.log1p(df_copy['volume'])
    vol_mean = log_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    vol_std = log_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
    stability = -(vol_std / (vol_mean + vol_std).replace(0.0, np.nan))

    # Lightweight modifier: compression weight based on normalized true range volatility
    prev_close = df_copy['close'].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([
        df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low'],
        (df_copy['high'] - prev_close).abs(),
        (df_copy['low'] - prev_close).abs()
    ], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    norm_tr = tr / df_copy['close']
    std_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    compression = 1.0 / (1.0 + std_tr)

    factor = stability * compression
    df_copy['factor_volume_stability_bounded'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_volume_stability_bounded']
